# Feature catalogue

Definitions version 1. Every feature is computed online by Flink and offline by dbt from the same definition (ADR-003).

## Semantics

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| event_time | `event_ts` |
| time_precision | `millisecond` |
| window_bounds | `inclusive` |
| includes_current | `True` |
| ties | `included` |
| watermark | `30s` |
| amounts | `usd_equivalent` |
| counted_transactions | `all` |

## Card features (key `card_id`)

| Feature | Kind | Window | Type | Version | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `txn_count_1m` | window_count | 1m | bigint | 1 | Transactions on the card in the last minute. |
| `txn_count_1h` | window_count | 1h | bigint | 1 | Transactions on the card in the last hour. |
| `txn_count_24h` | window_count | 24h | bigint | 1 | Transactions on the card in the last 24 hours. |
| `txn_amount_sum_1h` | window_sum | 1h | decimal(18,2) | 1 | Sum of transaction amounts on the card in the last hour. |
| `txn_amount_sum_24h` | window_sum | 24h | decimal(18,2) | 1 | Sum of transaction amounts on the card in the last 24 hours. |
| `distinct_merchants_1h` | window_count_distinct | 1h | bigint | 1 | Distinct merchants the card paid in the last hour (card testing). |
| `amount_vs_avg_30d` | ratio_to_prior_mean | 30d | double | 1 | Amount divided by the card's mean amount over the previous 30 days, excluding the current transaction; null when the card has no earlier transaction in the window. |
| `km_from_last_txn` | distance_from_previous | - | double | 1 | Haversine distance in km to the card's previous card-present transaction; null for online transactions and for the first card-present one (impossible travel). |
| `minutes_since_last_txn` | minutes_since_previous | - | double | 1 | Minutes since the card's previous card-present transaction; null for online transactions and for the first card-present one (impossible travel). |

## Customer features (key `customer_id`)

| Feature | Kind | Window | Type | Version | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `new_device_24h` | first_seen_within | 24h | boolean | 1 | True when the transaction's session device was first seen for this customer in the last 24 hours; null for card-present transactions (no session). Account takeover. |
| `profile_change_24h` | changed_within | 24h | boolean | 1 | True when the customer's email, phone or address changed in the last 24 hours, from CDC updates to customers. Account takeover. |

## Merchant features (key `merchant_id`)

| Feature | Kind | Window | Type | Version | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `merchant_refund_rate_7d` | status_rate | 7d | double | 1 | Reversals that happened at the merchant in the last 7 days, divided by its transactions created in the last 7 days; null when it had none. Point in time: a reversal counts from when it happened, not from when the transaction was created. |
